flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi framework/workflows/notification_sms_email/{jobs/NotificationSmsEmailJob, helpers/NotificationSmsEmailHelper (queryRecordsForReminder, batchPreloadContactInfo, refreshContactInfo, refreshIndividualContactInfo, getContactInfoFromSingpass, validateContactInfo, loadAllExcludedIds)}, framework/schedulers/NotificationJobsScheduler, framework/controllers/NotificationSmsEmailController, workflows/furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper (offender_tel_no from the furnish form), resources cron-schedules-prod.properties (cron.enareminder.datahive, cron.notification.enabled). Other repos: no driver mobile check code
note: Status 'Demo paid (50% of 75%)'; demo_remark: Vault Code Split (Vault must run because the notice needs vehicle and owner info for ANS; Vault connection permission is granted to the App Service) - cannot verify from repo. There is no flow deck, so Sesuai means the code follows the story text. The mobile check before the electronic reminder is done by the same eNotification cron as the owner/hirer reminders (OCMS12.3, OCMS12.18); the reminder query does not distinguish owner/hirer/driver, so driver notices at stage DN1 are included. Two findings: (1) the refresh of the latest mobile from DataHive (Singpass) is locked by cron.enareminder.datahive=false in dev, uat and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so the number on the record is used, which for a driver comes from the furnish form; (2) cron.notification.enabled=false in all environments (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), the job only runs through POST /notification-sms-email/execute; OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed) says 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate'. A driver with ID type B (company) gets no reminder at DN1 because the DN1 email is skipped. 'DOS' is read as DataHive; DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Epic OCMS9 is not in the repo as a document.
recommendation: Claim partially. The DN1 stage selection and contact validation logic exist; the latest-mobile check from DataHive is switched off by a flag and the eNotification cron is not active in any environment. Confirm with URA when cron.enareminder.datahive and cron.notification are enabled in PROD before billing this story in full.

steps.step: After the driver's 1st letter (DN1) is processed, the notice at stage DN1 becomes a candidate for the electronic reminder
steps.detail: The DN1 letter moves last_processing_stage to DN1 (ToppanUploadHelper.java:1514). The eNotification job calls queryRecordsForReminder (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:162), which selects notices with last_processing_stage IN (RD1, RD2, RR3, DN1, DN2, DR3), offender_indicator Y, ID not on the exclusion list, no notification record yet at the same stage, not an I/D/V vehicle, and a due date (last_processing_date + parameter POS + PDD) inside the ENOTEDAYS window (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1109-1151). The query does not distinguish owner/hirer/driver, so a driver at DN1 is included. Sebagian because the precondition 'the letter has been sent' is only seen through stage DN1; while the Toppan upload is blocked (application-prod.properties:86) the stage still advances without the file being delivered (ToppanUploadJob.java:424-444, OCMS-DF-2026-192), so stage DN1 does not prove that the driver received the letter. The ENOTEDAYS parameter row for DN1 is in the DB, cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: OCMS checks the driver's latest mobile number from DOS (Singpass via DataHive)
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and refreshContactInfo for all records (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-187). refreshContactInfo only queries DataHive when cron.enareminder.datahive=true (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2468-2477); the value is false in dev, uat and prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48), so the offender_tel_no already on the record is used. For a driver, that number is the one the furnisher typed in the form (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:557-558), not the latest number from DOS. The live path exists: getContactInfoFromSingpass fetches CONTACT and validates a minimum of 8 characters (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2716-2740). Same fit as OCMS12.18. DOS = DataHive cannot be confirmed from the repo; Vault/DataHive access in the environment cannot be verified from the repo.

steps.step: The electronic reminder is only prepared when the individual driver has a valid mobile; opt-outs and passports are skipped
steps.detail: validateContactInfo rejects a record with contactError or an individual without phoneNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2291). The job drops IDs in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list and ID type P/PASSPORT before the SMS is prepared (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226, 237) and skips records with invalid contact (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-266); there is no fallback for reminder stages. Note: loadAllExcludedIds returns an empty set when the query fails (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1207-1214), so the opt-out list is fail-open. A driver with ID type B (company) needs an email, but the email for DN1 is skipped because no template exists (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:311-317), so a company driver gets no reminder; the story only mentions mobile.

steps.step: The check runs automatically in the daily batch before the electronic reminder is sent
steps.detail: NotificationJobsScheduler runs processMainFlow daily at 11:00 (cron.notification.schedule=0 0 11 * * ?, cron-schedules-prod.properties:237), but only when cron.notification.enabled=true (NotificationJobsScheduler.java:42-60); the value is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236, comment on line 234: 'Disabled in PROD to prevent sending SMS/Email notifications'), uat (238) and dev (239). The job can be triggered manually through POST /notification-sms-email/execute (NotificationSmsEmailController.java:38). OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed) says 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate'. The value on the PROD server cannot be verified from the repo.
